# Sanctum Sound

> Professional recording studio and rehearsal rooms in Warsaw — recording, mixing, rehearsals, and equipment rental for bands and artists.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Sanctum Sound studio, gear, services, and contact.
- [Recording](/recording): Vocal and instrument recording, mixing, and production services.
- [Rehearsals](/rehearsals): Acoustically treated rehearsal rooms with full backline.
- [Rent](/rent): PA systems, microphones, and stage equipment rental.
- [Price](/price): Hourly and per-song pricing for recording, rehearsals, mixing, and rental.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, phone, social links, and map for the Warsaw studio.
